name: Magma Wave
body:
School evocation [earth, fire]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 7

Components: V, S,M/DF (a piece of volcanic rock)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 50 ft.

Area: Cone-shaped burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

A cone of thick, heavy magma and molten rock shoots from your fingertips. Any creature in the area of the takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6), half of which is fire damage and half of which is bludgeoning. A successful Reflex saves halves the damage. Size Medium or smaller victims who fail their save and are touching the ground must make a second save or be knocked down and trapped under a 4 ft. high carpet of cooling magma and are unable to act until the magma vanishes one round later. Flammable materials ignite if the magma touches them, as if hit by alchemist’s fire. A character can 134 extinguish burning items as a full-round action, provided he is able to act.
